_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees added by the RISK-STATE RESTORE fix
for an account with NO live sandbox behind it (a keyless paper-only
account, built by `bot_runner.py` with `api_key_id=None`).
A is the legacy projection removed: before the paper/live split there was
ONE sandbox of counters, persisted at the TOP LEVEL of the payload. For an
account that cannot trade live at all, that top level WAS its own paper
loss streak -- so it is restored into the PAPER sandbox. Without the
projection the paper counters start at zero, the PAPER gate opens on them,
and the next `save_state()` writes the zeros back: the streak that was
blocking the account is lost, which is the production incident the whole
restore exists to prevent.
B is the early return no longer applying the PAPER state. The live section
carries its own day stamp and the paper section carries its own, so a live
section belonging to another UTC day says NOTHING about the paper section.
The early return used to only scope-CHECK the paper sub-payload: a paper
section stamped TODAY was never applied and never latched, so the paper
counters restarted at zero and the PAPER gate opened on them.
C is the unreadable-VALUE latch removed. 'Keep the in-memory value' is
only fail-closed if the in-memory value is a MEASUREMENT, and at start-up
it is the process-born zero. So an unreadable persisted value is UNKNOWN,
and unknown must never be more permissive than known: the gate fails
closed and the state is not re-persisted (writing the zeros would LAUNDER
the unknown state into the payload).
D is the calendar-day check removed. A non-blank day stamp that is not a
calendar day ('unknown', '2026-13-45') cannot be compared with today's
stamp, so it is UNREADABLE -- not 'another day'. Reading it as 'another
day' discards the counters, restores them as ZEROS and re-opens a gate
that was closed.
E is the RESERVING placeholder no longer carrying the signal's own mode.
`_process_signal` inserts the placeholder before it knows the mode, so the
placeholder carried `LivePosition`'s default of 'live'. A close is booked
into the sandbox its POSITION names, and the emergency stop flattens
RESERVING positions too -- so a PAPER signal's placeholder moved the LIVE
loss streak and could close the LIVE gate on a simulated loss.
G is the non-finite check removed. NaN and +/-Infinity are not
measurements, they are the result of an arithmetic accident, and every
comparison against them is silently FALSE -- `nan < 0` is False, so a day's
PnL of NaN is read by the loss guard as 'no loss today'. json.dumps writes
NaN as the literal `NaN` and json.loads reads it straight back, so such a
value survives a save/restore round trip and reaches the guard exactly as a
number would. Measured: the same payload with -5000.0 closed the PAPER
gate, and with NaN left it OPEN with no unknown-state latch.
H is OverflowError no longer caught. `int(float('inf'))` raises
OverflowError, which is NOT a ValueError, so a persisted INFINITE loss
streak escapes the reader as an exception instead of an unknown -- and an
exception thrown out of the restore is not a fail-closed restore.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/risk_restore_paper_only_account.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: A: the legacy top level is no longer projected onto the PAPER section
B: the early return discards the PAPER state instead of applying it
mutations.replace: pass  # MUTATION: the paper state is not applied on its own scope

mutations.label: C: an unreadable persisted VALUE no longer fails closed
mutations.needle:
self._mark_guard_state_scope_unknown(scope)
        logger.critical(
            "[RiskGuard] The persisted %s could NOT be read, so that sandbox's "
mutations.replace:
logger.critical(
            "[RiskGuard] The persisted %s could NOT be read, so that sandbox's "

mutations.label: D: a day stamp that is not a calendar day is read as readable
E: the RESERVING placeholder is no longer stamped with the signal's mode
F: a null PAPER section is read as a legacy payload instead of as corruption
G: a persisted number that is not FINITE is read as a measurement again
H: an INFINITE persisted number escapes the reader as an exception again
